Name: robust_small_sample_classification
Title: Robust Image Classification Under Limited Labels
Experiment: Compare supervised learning, transfer learning, and consistency regularization under several labeled-data budgets. Report accuracy, calibration, robustness to distribution shift, and computational cost.

Name: efficient_multimodal_fusion
Title: Efficient Multimodal Fusion for Scientific Data
Experiment: Evaluate early, late, and gated fusion for images and structured metadata. Include missing-modality tests, ablations, uncertainty calibration, and inference-cost comparisons.
